_comment: Claude Code config for the Animate CC Pipeline. Commit this file so any device opening the repo gets the same MCP server registered. Local-only overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored).

animate-cc._phase: Registered in Phase 3a; first real tool ships in Phase 3b. Until 3b ships, the server file does not exist and Claude Code will warn about a missing server — this is expected.

permissions._comment: Allow Bash commands that are routinely needed for this pipeline: git ops, embedded Python invocations, file ops. Adjust per-device in settings.local.json if needed.
